server.name: viktor89-inference-claude
server.instructions: Three media-generation tools for Claude. image_gen_tool: text-to-image with ideogram4_fast. image_edit_tool: edit a source image (passed as base64 init_image) with Flux2 dev turbo. video_gen_tool: text-to-video with MiniMax-H3 ref2vid; the prompt is automatically rewritten into the structured MiniMax-H3 video-prompt format before generation. Every result is returned base64-encoded (image as MCP image content, video as an embedded blob resource), with a text note restating the MIME type.

models.title: ideogram4_fast text-to-image
models.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using ideogram4_fast.

models.title: Flux2 dev turbo image edit
models.description: Edit a source image according to a text prompt using Flux2 dev turbo. Pass the source image as init_image (base64, no data-URI prefix). The output resolution is derived from the input image.

models.title: MiniMax-H3 ref2vid text-to-video
models.description: Generate a short video from a text prompt using MiniMax-H3 ref2vid. The prompt is automatically rewritten into the structured MiniMax-H3 video-prompt format before generation.
